name: aeion-observability-forum
data_sources_text:
Frozen feature brief and merged dependency interfaces from [PLAN.md](../PLAN.md).
The approved [product architecture](../ARCHITECTURE.md) is Quarkus/Java + PostgreSQL +
React DOM/TypeScript web. Paths refer to the separate product repository, not Observability.
Content and model output are untrusted. Canonical definition: the aeion-core AxiomSpec specification named under Intent.
outputs_text:
An artifact restricted to the declared write scopes, with checks and refusals described below.
The protected factory independently validates it; builder reports cannot certify completion.
Backend tests use JUnit/Quarkus and disposable PostgreSQL; browser behavior uses the React
production build. A previous SQLite/Expo receipt does not qualify this architecture.
invariants_text:
This invariant and the acceptance cases belong to planned protected check `agora-{id}`.
The supervisor freezes external acceptance before implementation; candidate code cannot change the verifier.
determinism_text:
Use explicit bounds, versioned inputs, a frozen clock and seed where relevant. Model-generated
artifacts remain untrusted until checked; no model output grants runtime authority.
